'''Dai Utrila''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] servant to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] sometime between [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]] and [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. She was the triplet of [[Koya Utrila]] and [[Rihn Utrila]].
